description: Guidance-representation experiments layered on suite v3. A variant changes exactly one source of the conditions-v3.json guidance and inherits one v3 feedback policy, so its cells are compared against that policy's cells. Variants are opt-in: the default prepare output and the required measured matrix remain the three v3 feedback policies.

variants.description: The guidance-only policy with ai/component-catalog.json replaced, in place, by the generated markdown component reference: ai/components/README.md plus the pages for the components and elements the case's application files already reference.
